_comment: Managed policies for the lal.gg beamer kiosk. Installed to /etc/chromium/policies/managed/lalgg.json. The URL allow-list is the main lockdown: the browser can only reach lal.gg, the Directus asset host and localhost. Add hosts your slides embed (e.g. a video CDN) to URLAllowlist.
_comment_startup: No HomepageLocation/RestoreOnStartupURLs here: start-kiosk.sh passes the URL on the command line; a hard-coded policy URL would override a changed MANAGE_URL.
